pr_title: userdbd: make sure we don't exit under pressure

issue_context.title: userdbd kills itself after git+ssh logins frequently
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

253

### Used distribution

archlinux

### Linux kernel version used

6.2.2-arch1-1

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

_No response_

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

* userdbd should have no issues with high frequency normal logins
* userdbd should not fail restarting itself

### Steps to reproduce the problem

this is normal git usage - with `KillUserProcesses=yes` in logind.conf or `loginctl` would show 8192 "active" sessions and refuse to work normally, which imo is another bug

comments:
hmm yeah just a casual glance at the code it seems like a fairly obvious bug:

This block will request workers as fast as requests come in:
https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/v253/src/userdb/userwork.c#L543-L561

But the recipient process of the SIGUSR2 spawning the workers just exits when the ratelimit triggers, which apparently wasn't an expected normal behavior when authored:
https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/v253/src/userdb/userdbd-manager.c#L234-L239

review_comments:
well, not sure. the main error here is the flood of spawn requests, the fact that none of the children stick is secondary to that. Hence I think we shold propagate UCLEAN here, as indicative of "something is wrong with our state machine"

hope that makes some sense?
